records.jp: ヒナちゃん、行きづらい？^00やっぱりユズも一緒に行こうか？
records.en_original: Hina, do you not want to go alone? Want me to come with you?
records.en_auxiliary: Hina, do you not want to go alone? Want me to come with you?
records.en: Hina, do you not want to go alone? Want me to come with you?

records.jp: 恋愛相談かー、うーん……。^00ユズ、あんまりそういうの得意じゃないし、^00ヒナちゃんに任せるね、うん
records.en_original: Relationship advice, huh? Hmm... I'm not too good with that stuff, so this one's all up to you, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Relationship advice, huh? Hmm... I'm not too good with that stuff, so this one's all up to you, Hina.
records.en: Relationship advice, huh? Hmm... I'm not too good with that stuff, so this one's all up to you, Hina.

records.jp: 放っておくのはかわいそうだって、^00ユズは思うんだけどなぁ……
records.en_original: Personally, I feel bad leaving her all alone...
records.en_auxiliary: Personally, I feel bad leaving her all alone.
records.en: Personally, I feel bad leaving her all alone...

records.jp: ……。え、あ、ごめん。^00早く暴走を止めてあげないとね……
records.en_original: ...Huh? Oh, sorry. We should hurry and stop her rampancy, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: ...Huh? Oh, sorry. We should hurry and stop her rampant Fragment, huh...
records.en: ...Huh? Oh, sorry. We should hurry and stop her rampancy, huh...

records.jp: 盗撮かぁ。^00……あ。ここにもカメラ……^00あったりしないよね！？
records.en_original: Candid photography, huh... Wait, you don't think there's a camera here, do you!?
records.en_auxiliary: A hidden camera, huh? Wait, you don't think there's a camera here too, do you?!
records.en: Candid photography, huh... Wait, you don't think there's a camera here, do you!?

records.jp: まさか、こんなに早く……！^00ヒナちゃん！^00今度も頑張って、一緒にあいつを……！
records.en_original: Really? Already!? Come on, Hina! Let's take him down for good this time!
records.en_auxiliary: Really? Already?! Come on, Hina! Let's take him down for good this time!
records.en: Really? Already!? Come on, Hina! Let's take him down for good this time!

records.jp: どんどんプレッシャーが強くなってる！^00このままじゃ……！
records.en_original: The pressure's building by the minute! If this keeps up...!
records.en_auxiliary: The pressure's building by the minute! If this keeps up...!
records.en: The pressure's building by the minute! If this keeps up...!

records.jp: ……あいつも本気みたいだね。^00こっちも本気でかからないと^00痛い目見ちゃうかも……！
records.en_original: ...Looks like they mean business. If we don't take this seriously, we might get hurt...!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Looks like they mean business. If we don't take this seriously, we might get hurt!
records.en: ...Looks like they mean business. If we don't take this seriously, we might get hurt...!

records.jp: ネカマ……ネカマかぁ。^00うーん……
records.en_original: A guy...who pretends to be a girl online? Huh...
records.en_auxiliary: You never know who you're talking to online...
records.en: A guy...who pretends to be a girl online? Huh...

records.jp: さてさてヒナちゃん！^00これからどうする？何かするー？
records.en_original: Hey, hey, Hina! What are you up to now? Wanna do something?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, hey, Hina! What are you up to now? Wanna do something?
records.en: Hey, hey, Hina! What are you up to now? Wanna do something?

records.jp: 活動もだいぶ慣れてきた感じかな？^00この調子でがんばっていこー！
records.en_original: It feels like we've gotten pretty good at our Reflector responsibilities, right? Let's keep it up!
records.en_auxiliary: It feels like we've gotten pretty good at our Reflector responsibilities, right? Let's keep it up!
records.en: It feels like we've gotten pretty good at our Reflector responsibilities, right? Let's keep it up!

records.jp: ヒーナちゃん！^00今日はどうしよっかー、えへへー
records.en_original: Hiiinaaa! What should we do today? Eheheh.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiiinaaa! What should we do today? Eheheh.
records.en: Hiiinaaa! What should we do today? Eheheh.

records.jp: 文化祭ももうすぐだねー、うんうん。^00……すっごく、楽しみにしてるんだけどな。^00えっ？　ううん、何でもない！
records.en_original: The culture festival's almost here! ...I'm really looking forward to it, but...... Huh? Oh, it's nothing!
records.en_auxiliary: The culture festival's almost here! I'm really looking forward to it, but... Huh? Oh, it's nothing!
records.en: The culture festival's almost here! ...I'm really looking forward to it, but...... Huh? Oh, it's nothing!

records.jp: あの人に呼び出されたの、屋上だったっけ。^00気を付けて行ってきてね
records.en_original: She said she'd meet you on the rooftop? Be careful and good luck.
records.en_auxiliary: She said she'd meet you on the rooftop? Be careful and good luck.
records.en: She said she'd meet you on the rooftop? Be careful and good luck.

records.jp: 相談に乗ってほしい子とは^00屋上で待ち合わせしてるんだ。^00待たせるのも悪いし、さっそく行ってみよう
records.en_original: I told the girl who wanted to talk to us that we'd meet her on the rooftop. Let's not keep her waiting!
records.en_auxiliary: I told the girl who wanted to talk to us that we'd meet her on the rooftop. Let's not keep her waiting!
records.en: I told the girl who wanted to talk to us that we'd meet her on the rooftop. Let's not keep her waiting!

records.jp: どうするかはヒナちゃんに任せるよ。^00……ライムにとっては、どっちに転んでも^00損にはならないし
records.en_original: What do you want to do? It's your choice. ...Neither one's a loss for me.
records.en_auxiliary: What do you want to do? It's your choice. Neither one's a loss for me.
records.en: What do you want to do? It's your choice. ...Neither one's a loss for me.

records.jp: 早くコモンにリープしましょう。^00きっとまた、フラグメントが……
records.en_original: Let's hurry and leap to the Common. I'm sure another Fragment is waiting...
records.en_auxiliary: Let's hurry and leap to the Common. I'm sure another Fragment is waiting.
records.en: Let's hurry and leap to the Common. I'm sure another Fragment is waiting...

records.jp: 盗撮か……、うん。^00これは、もしかすると……
records.en_original: Voyeur photography, huh...? I see. Could it be...?
records.en_auxiliary: A hidden camera, huh? I see. Could it be...?
records.en: Voyeur photography, huh...? I see. Could it be...?

records.jp: さっきの歪みのせいで原種が……！？^00とにかく、迎え撃たないと！
records.en_original: Did that distortion draw a Sephira our way!? We've got to stop it!
records.en_auxiliary: Did that distortion draw a Sephira our way?! We've got to stop it!
records.en: Did that distortion draw a Sephira our way!? We've got to stop it!

records.jp: これだけのフラグメント……！^00くっ、急がないと……
records.en_original: How do we have so few Fragments...!? Tch, we've got to hurry......
records.en_auxiliary: How do we have so few Fragments?! Tch, we've got to hurry...
records.en: How do we have so few Fragments...!? Tch, we've got to hurry......

records.jp: 原種……！^00でも、この力は……。^00前に見たときより……！
records.en_original: A Sephira...! But, this strength... It's a lot stronger than the last time we saw it...!
records.en_auxiliary: A Sephira! But, this strength... It's a lot stronger than the last time we saw it!
records.en: A Sephira...! But, this strength... It's a lot stronger than the last time we saw it...!

records.jp: 近頃多いって聞くしね、ネカマ。^00心配しすぎならいいんだけど
records.en_original: I've heard there are a lot of guys posing as girls on the internet lately. ...I hope I'm worrying for nothing.
records.en_auxiliary: I've heard there are a lot of guys posing as girls on the internet lately. I hope I'm worrying for nothing.
records.en: I've heard there are a lot of guys posing as girls on the internet lately. ...I hope I'm worrying for nothing.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん。^00何かあったらライムに言って。^00……必ず力になってみせるから
records.en_original: Hina, let me know if you need anything, okay? ...I promise I'll help you out.
records.en_auxiliary: Hina, let me know if you need anything, okay? I promise I'll help you out.
records.en: Hina, let me know if you need anything, okay? ...I promise I'll help you out.

records.jp: フラグメントを集めていけば、^00原種にだって対抗できるようになる。^00ヒナちゃん、頑張ろうね
records.en_original: If we keep collecting Fragments, we'll even be able to defeat the Sephirot. Let's keep going, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: If we keep collecting Fragments, we'll be able to defeat the Sephira. Let's keep going, Hina.
records.en: If we keep collecting Fragments, we'll even be able to defeat the Sephirot. Let's keep going, Hina.

records.jp: ……ふぅ。^00ううん、気にしないで
records.en_original: ...*sigh* Oh, it's nothing.
records.en_auxiliary: ...*Sigh* Oh, it's nothing.
records.en: ...*sigh* Oh, it's nothing.

records.jp: 文化祭……。^00ライムは……
records.en_original: The culture festival... I'm...
records.en_auxiliary: The culture festival... I'm...
records.en: The culture festival... I'm...

records.jp: 陸上部の部室で隠しカメラが見つかって。^00まだ犯人も捕まってないみたいだし、^00すっごく不安なんだよね……
records.en_original: They found a hidden camera in the track team's locker room, but they haven't found the culprit yet. I'm worried...
records.en_auxiliary: They found a hidden camera in the track team's locker room, but they haven't found the culprit yet. I'm worried...
records.en: They found a hidden camera in the track team's locker room, but they haven't found the culprit yet. I'm worried...

records.jp: ……よし、ハイスコア。^00……ん？　何か用？
records.en_original: ...Alright, high score! ...Hm? You need something?
records.en_auxiliary: ...All right, high score! ...Hm? You need something?
records.en: ...Alright, high score! ...Hm? You need something?

records.jp: 私は悪くない、私は悪くない……。^00全部、ピアノが……ピアノが悪いせい……
records.en_original: It's not my fault, can't be my fault... It's all the piano's... The piano's fault...
records.en_auxiliary: It's not my fault, can't be my fault. It's the piano. It's... It's the piano...
records.en: It's not my fault, can't be my fault... It's all the piano's... The piano's fault...

records.jp: よし、レアゲット……え？^00あ、うん。よろしく……
records.en_original: Yeah! I got a rare one! ...Huh? Oh, yeah, nice to meet you...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! I got a rare one! ...Huh? Oh, yeah, nice to meet you.
records.en: Yeah! I got a rare one! ...Huh? Oh, yeah, nice to meet you...

records.jp: え、今……？^00えと、フリスペ！……見てるんだけど
records.en_original: Hm? Right now? Oh, I'm looking at FreeSpace...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? Right now? Oh, I'm looking at FreeSpace. Why?
records.en: Hm? Right now? Oh, I'm looking at FreeSpace...

records.jp: あ、うん。普段はソシャゲやってるの。^00えっと、こういうのなんだけど……
records.en_original: Ah, yeah. I'm usually into social games. Um, they look like this...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, yeah. I'm usually into social games. Um, they look like this...
records.en: Ah, yeah. I'm usually into social games. Um, they look like this...

records.jp: あ、白井さん。あのね、私ね！^00すっごいレアなキャラ、ゲットしたのー！^00えへへ、嬉しくてしょうがなくってー！
records.en_original: Oh, Shirai. Guess what?! I got a super rare character! Ehehe, I'm sooo excited!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Shirai. Guess what?! I got a super rare character! Ehehe, I'm sooo excited!
records.en: Oh, Shirai. Guess what?! I got a super rare character! Ehehe, I'm sooo excited!

records.jp: えーと。白井、さん……だっけ？^00ま、せいぜいよろしくね
records.en_original: Erm... Shirai, was it? Anyway, nice to meet you.
records.en_auxiliary: Erm... Shirai, was it? Anyway, nice to meet you.
records.en: Erm... Shirai, was it? Anyway, nice to meet you.

records.jp: 文化祭委員、ちゃんとこなしてよね。^00途中で放り出したりしたら承知しないわよ
records.en_original: Try to keep up with festival committee duties. If you give up partway through, <CR>I won't forgive you!
records.en_auxiliary: Try to keep up with festival committee duties. If you give up partway through, <CR>I'll make you regret it!
records.en: Try to keep up with festival committee duties. If you give up partway through, <CR>I won't forgive you!

records.jp: 最近頑張ってるみたいじゃない。^00ふふ。文化祭、楽しみにしてるから
records.en_original: I heard you've been working hard lately. Hehe, I can hardly wait for the festival!
records.en_auxiliary: I heard you've been working hard lately. Hehe, I can hardly wait for the festival!
records.en: I heard you've been working hard lately. Hehe, I can hardly wait for the festival!

records.jp: あなたのことならいくらでも手伝うわよ。^00さ、何でも言ってよね、日菜子
records.en_original: I'm here to help you in any way you need. Just tell me what to do, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm here to help you in any way you need. Just tell me what to do, Hinako.
records.en: I'm here to help you in any way you need. Just tell me what to do, Hinako.

records.jp: ふふふ、困ったことがあったら聞いてね？^00あたし、これでもクラス委員だから！^00親切な大矢さんって呼ばれてるからっ！
records.en_original: Hehehe. If you have any questions, just ask. Not only am I a committee member, but everyone calls me the Q&A Queen!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe. If you have any questions, just ask. Not only am I a committee member, but everyone calls me the Q&A Queen!
records.en: Hehehe. If you have any questions, just ask. Not only am I a committee member, but everyone calls me the Q&A Queen!

records.jp: というわけで早速学生生活のアドバイス！^00迷ったら校内マップを見よっ！^00あ、生徒手帳の後ろの方に載ってるからね
records.en_original: Here's my first school survival tip! If you get lost, check the school map! It's in your student handbook.
records.en_auxiliary: Here's my first school survival tip! If you get lost, check the school map! It's in your student handbook.
records.en: Here's my first school survival tip! If you get lost, check the school map! It's in your student handbook.

records.jp: フリスペ！はチェックしてる？^00面白い記事とか、役立つ情報とか^00わりと載ってたりするんだよね
records.en_original: Have you been checking your FreeSpace account? It's got a lot of interesting articles and helpful information.
records.en_auxiliary: Have you been checking your FreeSpace account? It's got a lot of interesting articles and helpful information.
records.en: Have you been checking your FreeSpace account? It's got a lot of interesting articles and helpful information.

records.jp: みんな思春期だからかな？^00わりと悩みごと、抱えてたりするんだよね
records.en_original: Everyone has their own set of troubles. I guess that's part of being teenagers.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone has their own set of troubles. I guess that's part of being teenagers.
records.en: Everyone has their own set of troubles. I guess that's part of being teenagers.

records.jp: よかったら白井さんもみんなの悩みごと、^00聞いてあげてよ。^00親切にしてるといいことあるよ、きっと！
records.en_original: If you can, try lending an ear to everyone's concerns. I'm sure your kindness will pay off someday!
records.en_auxiliary: If you can, try lending an ear to everyone's concerns. I'm sure your kindness will pay off someday!
records.en: If you can, try lending an ear to everyone's concerns. I'm sure your kindness will pay off someday!

records.jp: 白井さんもクラスに馴染んで、^00あたしが教えられそうなことも^00もうあんまりないかなぁ……
records.en_original: Now that you've gotten used to our class, it may seem like there's little left for me to teach you...
records.en_auxiliary: Now that you've gotten used to our class, it may seem like there's little left for me to teach you...
records.en: Now that you've gotten used to our class, it may seem like there's little left for me to teach you...

records.jp: でも、大矢さんの親切に終わりはないから。^00ね、困ってることない？　ねぇねぇ～
